title: One Financing Basis to a Purchase under the Northbeam Promotional Financing Terms
content:
A purchase on an account of the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts range sits either on promotional financing or on the ordinary revolving balance, never on both, and the choice is fixed when the draw is booked.

## Interest follows the basis the purchase sits on

Interest is charged on a promotional plan at the promotional rate and on the revolving balance at the purchase rate, and the same amount is never charged at both rates in one statement period.

## Nothing moves between the two after the draw

A promotional plan may not be moved onto the revolving balance to lower the minimum payment, and a revolving balance may not be moved onto a promotional plan after the purchase.

## The test made on the purchase

The test is made on the purchase the draw was booked against, read from the account's own record of draws before a further draw is booked. Where a draw already stands against that purchase, a further draw against the same purchase on the other basis is not booked. Neither a different day nor a different plan reference makes it a fresh purchase: it is the purchase itself that carries one basis and one only.

## A returned promotional purchase

Where a promotional purchase is returned, the plan is reduced by the refund and the plan's end day does not move.

## Several plans standing at once

A profile may hold several promotional plans at once, each with its own end day, and a payment is applied to them as the product's allocation basis states.

## Cases that hold and cases that do not

**Holds.** A purchase booked onto a promotional plan at the draw stays on that plan, and the amount is charged at the promotional rate for that period and at no other rate.

**Holds.** A profile carries three promotional plans with three different end days, and a payment reaches them in the order the product's allocation basis gives.

**Does not hold.** A purchase booked onto a promotional plan is asked, later in its term, to be carried on the revolving balance instead so that the least payment falls. The plan is not moved onto the revolving balance.

**Does not hold.** An amount already carried on the revolving balance is asked to be put onto a promotional plan after the purchase. It is not moved onto a plan.

**Does not hold.** One amount is charged at the promotional rate and at the purchase rate in the same statement period. The same amount is never charged at both rates in one period.
